jobs.title: Allied Universal is hiring: Security Officer Part Time Armed Patrol Driver in Houston
jobs.description:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose.
While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.
As a Security Guard Part Time Armed Patrol Driver in Houston, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Retail/Malls, and more.
Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity.
As a Part‑Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform.
Learn more: aus.com/earnmore.
Join Allied Universal as an Armed Patrol Officer in a dynamic retail location, where you will conduct routine driving and foot patrols, maintain a visible presence to help discourage security‑related incidents, and deliver exceptional customer service.
This armed post offers the opportunity to support daily operations through strong communication, teamwork, and integrity while working in a caring, agile, and reliable culture.
Position Type: Part Time
Pay Rate: $22.00 / Hour
PRE‑EMPLOYMENT REQUIREMENTS (CONTRACTUAL)
* 21+ Years of Age (C101)
* Active Armed Guard Card/License (Texas only) (C122)
* Valid Driver’s License - AU Driver Policy Requirements (C123)
* 3+ Years' Combined Law Enforcement/Corrections/Military OR 5+ Years Armed Security Experience
JOB SCHEDULE
* Wed: 04:00 PM - 10:30 PM
* Thur: 04:00 PM - 10:30 PM
* Fri: 04:00 PM - 10:30 PM
* Sat: 04:00 PM - 10:30 PM
WHAT YOU’LL DO
* Provide customer service by carrying out security‑related procedures, site‑specific policies, and/or appropriate emergency response activities at a retail location.
* Respond to incidents, disturbances, and/or critical situations in a calm, problem‑solving manner, documenting relevant details and communicating with site contacts and/or local authorities as needed.
* Conduct regular and random armed patrols throughout the store, entrances, parking areas, loading and receiving zones, and perimeter to help deter unwanted activity and identify unusual conditions.
* Monitor access points, high‑traffic areas, and/or asset‑sensitive locations, assisting with security‑related concerns involving customers, team members, vendors, and deliveries.
* Support closing, opening, and/or cash movement activities when assigned, maintaining a visible presence and following post orders and armed post protocols.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
* Possess 3 or more years of combined law enforcement, corrections, or military experience, or 5 or more years of armed security‑related experience.
* Be at least 21 years of age.
* A valid driver’s license is required in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements.
* Possess a Texas Level III Armed Certification.
* Be at least 21 years of age for armed roles.
* Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
* As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
* Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
* As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
* Participate in industry‑specific security training programs.
* Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
* A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.
WHY JOIN US
* Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
* Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
* Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
* Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.
Allied Universal® is an
Equal Opportunity Employer.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law.
For more information: www.aus.com.
If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department.
To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

jobs.title: Armed Officer Patrol
jobs.description:
Armed Security Officer - Residential Community

Pay: $22/hr
Location: Houston, TX 77004 (TSU Area)
Schedule: Part-Time, Overnight, 28 hours/week
  • Friday: 5:00PM - 12 Midnight
  • Saturday: 5:00PM - 12 Midnight
  • Sunday: 5:00PM - 12 Midnight
  • Monday: 5:00PM - 12 Midnight
City Security Services is seeking a professional, dependable, and alert Armed Security Officer to provide security services within a residential community. In this role, you will conduct vehicle and foot patrols, monitor resident and visitor activity, verify guest access, respond to security incidents, and maintain a visible security presence throughout the property. Successful candidates must be able to remain calm under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and handle emergency situations with professionalism and confidence.
Responsibilities:
  • Conduct vehicle and foot patrols throughout a residential community
  • Monitor resident and visitor traffic entering the property
  • Verify guest access and assist visitors with directions as needed
  • Conduct perimeter checks of community amenities, parking areas, and common spaces
  • Respond to resident complaints, disturbances, and suspicious activity
  • Complete detailed Daily Activity Reports and Incident Reports
  • Contact law enforcement, fire, or EMS personnel when emergency situations arise
  • Provide exceptional customer service while maintaining a visible security presence
Requirements:
  • Active Level III Commissioned Security License
  • Active Drivers License with a clean Driving Record
  • Reliable attendance and ability to work overnight shifts
Benefits of working for City Security Services:
  • Weekly direct deposit paychecks
  • Advanced Security Officer training
  • Career advancement opportunities
  • Ongoing field training provided
  • Recognition programs

Why Join City Security Services?
City Security Services is a growing security company committed to professionalism, accountability, and continuous development. We invest in our employees through training, mentorship, and advancement opportunities that help build long-term careers in the security industry.
Our culture is to Educate, Train, Certify and REPEAT

If you are looking for a stable position where you can make a difference while growing your professional skills, we encourage you to apply today.

City Security Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
